title: Screen Targeted cDNA FASTQ Across Independent Gene Loci

catalog.notes: Native panel preparation reuses stored gene sets, exact reference bindings and immutable extension; optional project registration shows set/source/parent relationships in the graph. CLI and agents share discovery/build. Five-locus rehearsal including a junction-spanning read that still co-nominates a shared-exon alternative, then one explicitly completed FASTQ.gz chunk. Same-pass supplier checksums, request-bound cancellation, read-ahead progress, named sample coverage and class-bound co-nomination tables; explicit bounded summary-table verification. Post-start marker faults retain verified units as control_error, not cancellation or success. Partial seeds are not whole-read fit, molecule copies or isoform calls. All stages have inner-agent routes; Rust/native/calibration acceptance remains pending.
catalog.starting_state: Externally verified CLI and disposable synthetic project; actual loci and completed files are a separate follow-up
